title: [APAC] Keep vendor ACY on purchase invoice payables entry
summary: The posting engine in APAC regions now correctly preserves the vendor-calculated additional reporting currency on payables entries, preventing unbalanced ACY amounts and spurious residual entries when posting purchase invoices with blank currencies and non-zero vendor exchange rates.
key_points: Vendor-calculated additional currency amount (ACY) is now retained in the balancing payables entry instead of being replaced with zero
Source currency amount is calculated independently from LCY rather than reusing the ACY value
Fixes unbalanced ACY amounts that previously created residual entries in APAC preview posting scenarios
Change is isolated to APAC layer and does not affect W1 behavior or existing data structures
New test validates correct ACY handling for purchase invoices with vendor exchange rates
quote: The posting therefore left the full ACY amount unbalanced and created a separate residual entry.
